reviews.title: Complete waste of money
reviews.text:
First off, they charge you for every single thing. I am surprised they don’t charge you for every character you type you pay a weekly subscription or a six month subscription or a 12 month subscription then you pay for editing in songs it has already created, and you pay to record your voice to make your own cover. Seems to be just a very quick gold mine for the creator.

I downloaded this app a while ago when it was new I used it off and on for a little but it was pretty glitchy. Several months later I re-downloaded it because I figured they would’ve updated the glitches and fix the problem, they may have done so, but now it doesn’t even listen to the description or take it into account. Also for the same song I have written the lyrics out and it completely disregard to them altogether and writes its own lyrics i’m not even sure that it used any of my original lyrics . Even having a paid subscription, it’s still does not remotely do anything I type. I tried to edit the lyrics then afterwards, and I even bought and paid for the ability to edit the lyrics, it already created, it did not change the lyrics to what I wanted them to. I don’t know how are giving it such a high rating.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: The app works well and the AI features are impressive, but the marketing feels misleading. They imply the generated songs can be freely used, yet they don’t clearly mention that you must pay a significant additional fee to obtain the rights for each track. Considering users already pay an annual subscription, this makes commercial use impractical and disappointing.

reviews.title: Unfortunately not worth it
reviews.text: I was happy to pay the £5.99 to clone my voice and the £2.99 for the week subscription, but unfortunately the quality of generation is poor. The AI is not following my prompts and is generating songs with a Black American accent despite my voice being white British. It costs 2 credits to generate a song + make it with your own voice and you only get 10 credits on the £2.99 subscription. Unfortunately this app is not able to deliver on its promises. Can not recommend it.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time or money
reviews.text:
There are a lot of fundamental flaws with this app. The biggest being that if you pay for the pro version you’re still limited by how many songs you can create and nowhere does it say what your limit is. You can’t then pay even more to unlock 5+ songs which is crazy when you’re already paying a subscription! Where’s the value?

Not only that, you can edit a song but it uses a credit so you can’t simply tweak it and sometimes you have to as the au version of your lyrics can sing sentences too fast so it makes it difficult to understand what the are even singing/saying.

Didn’t enjoy the user experience at all and it’s all about money grabbing
